deviations.what: Canvas 1 'O1 Language picker · the first screen ever shown' (and c11 'O1 Language picker'): the frame shows the sealed mark and the 'Rukka Folio' wordmark above the choices and no heading; the app shows no mark and adds a heading 'Choose your language' and a subtitle 'You can change this later in Settings'
deviations.reason: [screen] DESIGN-PACK O1: 'with the Rukka Folio mark above. No other chrome'. The heading and subtitle are chrome the frame does not draw

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O1 Language picker: each language is a tall (~108 px) raised card with a navy accent bar on its left edge and the language name at ~24 px in its own script, no radio; the app draws 56 px outlined rows on the page colour, the name at body size (16 px) and a trailing radio circle
deviations.reason: [screen] DESIGN-PACK O1 rules 'three large tap targets … each rendered in its own script at 24px'; the app's rows are list rows with a radio. The raised card fill is the shared card gap (see S0.3)
deviations.authority: design/DESIGN-PACK.md §O1 (24 px, large tap targets); ADR 2026-10-05 §1

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O1 Language picker: no button — a tap on a language is the choice; the app adds a 'Continue' button pinned at the foot, disabled (grey fill) until a row is selected, and draws a selected state
deviations.reason: [screen] the app's select-then-continue was the conservative reading of an unruled default (⚠️ SPEC in s0_1_language_screen.dart). The frame draws neither a preselection nor a button, so 'nothing pre-selected' holds either way; DESIGN-PACK O1 says 'No other chrome'. Whether a tap commits directly is the owner's call — reported in open
deviations.authority: design/DESIGN-PACK.md §O1; ⚠️ SPEC s0_1_language_screen.dart:4 (07 §3.1 silent on a default)

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O1 Language picker: the choices sit in the lower-middle of the screen under the lockup; the app's sit at the top under the heading with empty space down to the button
